srList.sentence: The following exclusion criteria were considered: (1) a history of significant alcohol consumption (>21 standard drinks per week in men or >14 standard drinks per week in women) or virus-related chronic hepatitis; (2) a history of taking drugs that may cause steatosis, obstructive cholestasis, acute hepatitis, and infiltrative liver diseases, which may affect the reliability of LS measurements; (3) liver inflammation, as indicated by aspartate transaminase (AST) and/or alanine transaminase (ALT) elevation >5 times the normal limits.
